sections.title: Estar + Gerundio
sections.content:
To say that an action is in progress right now, Spanish uses **estar** followed by the gerund (*el gerundio*). For regular verbs ending in **-ar**, drop the *-ar* ending and add **-ando**:
- hablar → **hablando** (speaking)
- trabajar → **trabajando** (working)
- estudiar → **estudiando** (studying)
- cocinar → **cocinando** (cooking)

items.english: Right now I am studying Spanish.
Meg is speaking on the phone.

sections.content: Notice that the gerund form (**trabajando**) never changes for gender or number. Only the helping verb **estar** is conjugated!
